Hero.name: Nourhen Bourannen
Hero.tagline: I design and build complete web applications with the MERN stack, test them with a QA mindset, and I'm now growing into data science.

About.title: About me
About.text: I'm a junior full-stack developer based in Gafsa, Tunisia, with a degree in Computer Science from ISET Gafsa (Information Systems Development, 2026, with honors). I build web applications end to end with the MERN stack. My projects include an AI-powered commercial management platform built for ETAP in a team of two, and an AI study assistant that I deployed online. I also work as a freelance web QA tester, which taught me to check my own work the way a user would: testing workflows, documenting bugs clearly, and verifying fixes. I'm now studying for a master's degree in Data Science, learning Python and machine learning, and I'm looking for a web developer role, on-site or remote, where I can keep growing within a team.

Skills.title: Skills
Skills.learning: Currently building hands-on data projects as part of my Master's in Data Science.

bullets: Performed manual testing of websites and web applications.
Tested forms, login/authentication, navigation, and main user workflows.
Identified and documented functional and UI bugs.
Checked responsive behavior on different screen sizes and browsers.
Verified bug fixes and performed basic regression testing.
Prepared clear bug reports with reproduction steps and expected results.
Built two web applications with the MERN stack: a social media app and an e-commerce store.
Used Git for version control on both projects.
